primary_endpoint: Geometric mean ratio of Week 12 to baseline percentage liver fat assessed by MRI (Epanova versus placebo).
efficacy_outcome: Week 12/baseline liver-fat ratio was 0.98 with Epanova and 1.04 with placebo (p=0.407).
safety_signal: Serious adverse events: Epanova 1/25; fenofibrate 0/27; placebo 0/26. Deaths were not reported.
